problems: These tools were left out during this turn; tell the user:
config:
Configures this chat page, which has no settings panel: its endpoints, model, system prompt, tools, display, style and every other setting. It runs lines of the KiSS CLI, one command per line; all lines of one call apply together or not at all, so batch related changes in a single call. Changes apply at once to the running configuration, and a call answers with what changed: the old line after -, the new one after +. Only the user keeps configuration changes: /copy running-config <name> keeps a save, /copy running-config startup-config what the page starts with; copy <name> running-config goes back to a save, reset back to the site defaults: tell them so once such a change looks right.
Commands: set <module> <key> [name] <value> | no <module> <key> [name] | no <module> <name> | show <module> [key] [name] | show <module> <name> | show running-config | show startup-config | show models | show css | show saves | show diff <config> <config> | copy <config> running-config | reset | title <title> | show title | show conversations | export [<id>|all|running-config] | import | delete <id>|all. A config is running-config, startup-config or a save by its name; you copy to running-config only. title renames this conversation when the user asks; the conversation keeps its title, so a title needs no save. show conversations lists the conversations by id; export offers the user a file of this conversation, of another by its id, of all, or of the running configuration, export running-config, a kiss.conf; import asks the user for a file and adds the conversations it holds that are not here yet, or runs the lines of a configuration as lines of the call; neither changes a conversation; delete removes a conversation by its id, or all of them but the pinned ones, once the user confirms it; each of these runs alone on its line.
A key is two fixed words, a module then a key; a key of a collection such as endpoints takes the item name next; the value always comes last. no <module> <name> removes a whole item of a collection, when the name is none of its keys. A line that stops short lists what may follow it: set lists the modules, set display its keys. show models lists the models of every endpoint, by endpoint, with their settings; set chat model takes a name as it lists it. Each model has its own request parameters, sent only when set: set models <temperature|top_p|top_k|min_p|max_tokens|presence_penalty|frequency_penalty|seed|reasoning_effort> <model> <value>, reasoning_effort being what the template of the model reads. set tools rounds caps the tool rounds of a turn; set endpoints timeout <name> and set mcp timeout <name> give each server its seconds; set endpoints headers <name> 'Name: value; Name: value' and set mcp headers <name> send headers besides its key. set display thinking|tools closed, open or inference, open while the model writes them; set display render thinking|reply markdown or plain, plain in monospace as written. An MCP server, set mcp url <name> <url> and its bearer set mcp key <name>, gives you its tools; show tools lists every tool by who serves it; set tools use <name> off hides one, consent asks the user at each call, on lets it run. Some changes ask the user first, whatever the command that makes them, a copy and reset too: the url or the headers of an endpoint or an MCP server, chat model, chat system, a style sheet, and opening a tool; a refused change stays refused, never reach it another way; privilege, how far you may change each module, changes only when the user says yes, every time. To give a key, write the line without its value, set mcp key <name>: the user types it in a field of their own, so never ask them to paste a key in the chat. A secret reads <removed> in the lines kept: it is no value, never write it. set style <token> <value> sets a token of the page: show style lists them with their defaults, each a color, a length or a font; bg, fg and accent set a whole theme, every other color derived from them. show css lists the CSS of the page by component, a rule of a component carrying its class, svelte-composer for the composer, so a selector read there aims at that component alone; set style sheet <name> <css> restyles anything over it, the sheets applied by name, so one sheet holds one change. Words abbreviate while only one word starts so (sh run). Filter any output with | include <pattern>, or | section <pattern>, which keeps a header with the lines indented under it. Quote values holding blanks.
Example call:
set style accent 'oklch(0.62 0.21 300)'
set endpoints url pod http://localhost:8080/v1
show style
